dedupe_keys.name: gcom energy and emissions quality checks

description: The GCoM validation research team publishes R code for checking municipal energy and emissions reports. Its README describes preparation and quality checks for consumption, supply, inventories and policies, followed by comparisons with EDGAR version 7 for building and road-transport emissions. The repository provides code organisation and input-file guidance, with free public access under MIT. The comparison example selects European cities above 50,000 residents with post-1999 inventories, while the broader checks address GCoM reporting tables. Outputs can help assess inputs to municipal transition simulations in model-pypsa or model-muse-os. A caveat is that agreement between inventories depends on population boundaries, reporting years and emissions categories. Passing a consistency test does not establish complete or correct reporting. No R code or inventory comparison was executed.
